parts.title: Platform API · soundhub-robin
parts.body: A custom adapter, shipped in the soundhub-robin repo. It asks the SoundHub API for a project's recordings using the user's own SoundHub credentials, and identifies each one by SoundHub's recording ID.

parts.title: Nested folders · folder-layout
parts.body: Built in. Reads recordings straight off recorder cards or disks; the recorder and start time come from the file names, following a layout set in YAML.

parts.title: Bucket prefix · bucket-prefix
parts.body: Built in. Lists everything under a prefix in an S3 bucket. The object key is the recording's identity, so files must never be renamed.

parts.title: Spreadsheet · csv-list
parts.body: Built in. Takes the rows of a CSV, with the ID and audio columns named in YAML. The simplest way to hand ROBIN an exact list.

parts.title: ROBIN core
parts.body: Every adapter produces the same kind of list: a namespace, an ID and an audio location. The run keeps that list, so it never asks the source again.
